solution:
"""
URL: https://leetcode.com/problems/day-of-the-week/description/?envType=problem-list-v2&envId=vn57k9wr

1185. Day of the Week

Given a date, return the corresponding day of the week for that date.

The input is given as three integers representing the day, month and year respectively.

Return the answer as one of the following values {"Sunday", "Monday", "Tuesday", "Wednesday", "Thursday", "Friday", "Saturday"}.

Note: January 1, 1971 was a Friday.

Example 1:

Input: day = 31, month = 8, year = 2019
Output: "Saturday"

Example 2:

Input: day = 18, month = 7, year = 1999
Output: "Sunday"

Example 3:

Input: day = 15, month = 8, year = 1993
Output: "Sunday"

Constraints:

    The given dates are valid dates between the years 1971 and 2100.
"""


class Solution:
    def dayOfTheWeek(self, day: int, month: int, year: int) -> str:
        days_in_month = [31, 28, 31, 30, 31, 30, 31, 31, 30, 31, 30, 31]
        days_of_week = [
            "Friday",
            "Saturday",
            "Sunday",
            "Monday",
            "Tuesday",
            "Wednesday",
            "Thursday",
        ]

        def is_leap(y: int) -> bool:
            return (y % 4 == 0 and y % 100 != 0) or (y % 400 == 0)

        # Count total days from 1971/1/1 to the day before the given date
        total_days = 0

        # Add days for full years
        for y in range(1971, year):
            total_days += 366 if is_leap(y) else 365

        # Add days for full months in the current year
        for m in range(1, month):
            total_days += days_in_month[m - 1]
            if m == 2 and is_leap(year):
                total_days += 1

        # Add days in the current month
        total_days += day - 1

        return days_of_week[total_days % 7]


sol = Solution()

print(sol.dayOfTheWeek(31, 8, 2019))  # "Saturday"

assert sol.dayOfTheWeek(31, 8, 2019) == "Saturday"
assert sol.dayOfTheWeek(18, 7, 1999) == "Sunday"
assert sol.dayOfTheWeek(15, 8, 1993) == "Sunday"

assert sol.dayOfTheWeek(1, 1, 1971) == "Friday"
assert sol.dayOfTheWeek(28, 2, 1972) == "Monday"
assert sol.dayOfTheWeek(29, 2, 1972) == "Tuesday"
assert sol.dayOfTheWeek(1, 3, 1972) == "Wednesday"
assert sol.dayOfTheWeek(31, 12, 2100) == "Friday"
assert sol.dayOfTheWeek(1, 1, 2100) == "Friday"
assert sol.dayOfTheWeek(29, 2, 2000) == "Tuesday"
assert sol.dayOfTheWeek(28, 2, 1900) == "Sunday"
assert sol.dayOfTheWeek(1, 1, 2000) == "Saturday"
assert sol.dayOfTheWeek(15, 6, 1980) == "Sunday"
assert sol.dayOfTheWeek(31, 12, 1971) == "Friday"
assert sol.dayOfTheWeek(1, 2, 1971) == "Monday"
